contracts.name: common action envelope
contracts.summary: Shared preview, apply, rollback, warning, error, and log wrapper for backend actions.

contracts.name: action preview
contracts.summary: Single proposed change shown before an action applies.

contracts.name: action result
contracts.summary: Structured outcome for previews, applies, partial applies, failures, and rollbacks.

contracts.name: progress event
contracts.summary: Incremental status event for long-running backend work.

contracts.name: error and warning model
contracts.summary: User-facing warning and error structure with blocking state and remediation guidance.

contracts.name: backup and rollback metadata
contracts.summary: Saved state, restore-point status, and rollback action metadata.

contracts.name: protected item model
contracts.summary: Protected processes, services, drivers, apps, tasks, devices, and paths.

contracts.name: protected app catalog
contracts.summary: Protected app and dependency rules blocked by bulk uninstall previews.

contracts.name: process inventory
contracts.summary: Read-only process list with workload category, memory pressure, and safety classification.

contracts.name: process classification
contracts.summary: Game-session-aware process classification with protected, companion, target, safe-candidate, and demotion-candidate buckets.

contracts.name: performance profile
contracts.summary: Versioned priority, affinity, demotion, telemetry, and rollback profile.

contracts.name: game session profile
contracts.summary: Overwatch, OBS, Discord, and stream-focused profile shape.

contracts.name: process rule preview/apply result
contracts.summary: Per-rule preview or apply outcome for process scheduling changes.

contracts.name: process profile backup manifest
contracts.summary: Saved original process priority state used for rollback after confirmed profile apply.

contracts.name: uninstall app inventory
contracts.summary: Installed application list from registry, MSI, Appx, winget, or manual catalog sources.

contracts.name: app classification result
contracts.summary: Read-only classification of installed apps into normal, launcher, overlay, vendor, runtime, driver, security, Store/WebView2, anti-cheat, OBS/Discord dependency, and protected Windows buckets.

contracts.name: uninstall queue

contracts.name: official uninstall command preview

contracts.name: leftover scan result

contracts.name: cleanup deletion manifest

contracts.name: cleanup rollback/export metadata
contracts.summary: File backup, registry export, service state, scheduled task, startup entry, restore point, and rollback metadata for cleanup manifests.

contracts.name: driver hardware inventory
contracts.summary: Read-only machine, CPU, memory, GPU, and network hardware inventory.

contracts.name: installed driver info
contracts.summary: Installed device driver metadata for recommendation matching.

contracts.name: driver recommendation catalog
contracts.summary: Game-aware and hardware-aware driver recommendation entries.

contracts.name: game tag metadata
contracts.summary: Game process names, launchers, and optimization focus tags.

contracts.name: NVIDIA profile catalog entry
contracts.summary: NVIDIA Profile Inspector profile metadata and manual-apply gate.

contracts.name: telemetry snapshot
contracts.summary: Point-in-time performance, process, provider, and quality data.

contracts.name: report summary
contracts.summary: User-facing findings, metrics, recommended actions, and artifacts.
